extracted.name: Easy coronation chicken
extracted.description: Make a classic coronation chicken filling to serve with jacket potatoes or in sandwiches and salads. It's an excellent way to use up leftover chicken after a roast
ingredient_lines: 2-3 tsp mild curry powder to taste
instruction_lines: Mix the mayonnaise, curry powder, cinnamon, chutney and sultanas together and season with black pepper.
Add the shredded chicken and stir to coat in the sauce. Stir in 2 tbsp water to loosen if needed, then season and serve as desired.
